reason: The company is expanding its production capacity by 1200 TPD with a new Rs 500 Crore maize processing unit, which will significantly increase its top-line potential once operational.
why_now: The MoU was signed and disclosed to the exchange today, 2026-09-08.
source_headlines: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Limited: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange that the company has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), today, for setting up of a new, state of the art Maize Processing Unit with a maize grind capacity of 1200 TPD, for production of Maize Starch and its derivatives, entailing a CapEx of about Rs 500 Crores, in District Nashik of Maharashtra State.
